query: Hi there, I just had the cutest interaction with my neighbor's golden retriever this morning, it kept bringing me its favorite frisbee to play fetch with even though I was in a hurry to head out to the grocery store. Oh and I also just finished binging that new fantasy miniseries everyone's been talking about, the season finale had such an unexpected plot twist I spent half an hour reading fan theories about it online after I finished watching. I also tried a new matcha latte recipe at home yesterday, I added a little vanilla syrup and oat milk and it turned out way better than the ones I get at my local café, I think I'm going to make it part of my daily morning routine now. Anyway, I need help with a couple of my pending orders. First, for order #W9810810, can you modify the item 1355937109 to 9949163720, and use gift_card_7252880 as the payment method for this change? Then, for order #W3730488, I have two changes: first, modify the item 2913673670 to 9844888101, also using gift_card_7252880 as the payment method for this item change, and second, update the shipping address to 555 Highland Drive, Suite 872, New York, NY 10116, USA. Thank you!
